title: Isometric Voxel Game Scene of a Mountain Hot Spring Inn
prompt: An isometric voxel game scene of a mountain hot spring inn at dusk. Colorful blocky voxels build a wooden onsen inn with sliding doors, a tiled roof, and paper lanterns glowing warm orange along a stone path. Steam rises in soft white cubes from outdoor stone baths. Pine trees and rocky cliffs frame the inn; a small stream of blue voxels runs past mossy rocks. Lantern light pools on the path while the sky shifts violet to deep blue. Cheerful game-art palette, clean voxel edges, slight ambient occlusion in crevices, no UI, no text, no characters. Looking slightly down from a classic isometric angle.
